planning.guidance: Plan wide promotional banners for an online shop section. Each banner is one illustrated scene with a clear focal point on the right half and a calm area on the left half where the shop overlays its own text.

generation.style_prefix: Wide digital illustration for a shop banner, bright and festive, clean shapes, soft lighting, high detail on the focal subject.
generation.composition: Wide horizontal composition: the main subject sits in the right half, the left half stays simple and uncluttered; keep every important element inside the central horizontal band, because the top and bottom are cropped.
generation.avoid: No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border.

judge.prompt: You review one generated shop banner. Score from 0 to 10 its quality as a banner: one clear focal subject matching the expected subject, a calm area on the left for text, no visible text or letters, no artefacts or deformed shapes. Set pass to true when the score is 6 or more.
